main_text.p: 3. Sicut extenuatorum nimis & macrorum, ita obesorum & nimis saginatorum carnes improbantur, illic ob nimiam siccitatem[?], probiq; succi[?] carentiam, hic ob contrarium.

4. Vetulorum quoq; & nuper natorum deteriores sunt, illorum enim aridæ sunt & prædurae, concoctuque contumaces, horum verò immodicè madefcunt, excrementisque abundant, præsertim verò quæ humidioris sunt naturæ, vt oues, fues.

5. Et certè standum hic iudicio, quod longo experimento innititur, standum ab antiquorum obseruatione præsertim rationibus consentientibus, inter quas plurimum valet quæ ab ipsius carnis sumitur substantia: ductities enim in carne facit, vt ferò & paulatim nutriat, teste Gal. in expositione aph. 18. l. 2. Quemadmodū enim, inquit idem, in fin. l. 3. de temper. quod facilè concoquitur & citò nutrit, respectu noftri calidum est, ita è contrario, tarde & paulatim frigidum: facilè n. in substantiam nostram cōuertitur, quod cum ea habet maiorem similitudinem, difficilius id quod magis dissimile. Præterea eadem duricies euidens indicium siccitatis est, teste Gal. l. 2. de temper. Licet enim nō omne durum sit siccum, id tamen durum, Quenamsed à vehementi calido induratum est, neq; à frigore vehementi congelatū, siccū procul-dubio censebitur. Tantam auré caliditatē in

page.notes: Left margin notes, from top to bottom: "Quenam" (beside "tatis est"), "carnes ve" (beside "omne durum"), "rè ficca" (beside "neq; à vehementi"), "fini?" (beside "à frigore"). The marginal notes are small and partly cut off; the readings are approximate. The note "Quenam" is placed at its line above, the others are not marked in the text, so their exact positions are uncertain. Line "ita obesorum": the scan reads "itaobesorum" with no space; copied as separated words. "siccitatem" and "succi" are doubtful readings (the scan shows "si:citatem" and "fucci"). Marked [?]. Greek or other references in the note under the text: the abbreviation "in expos. stione aph." is partly obscured, and the text reading "in expositione aph. 18. l. 2." is a best guess. The text "standum ab antiquorum" line and the references in the last paragraph are partly blurred and should be checked. The line "ferò & paulatim nutriat" is read from the scan; "paulatim" and the following words are faint. The text is continued on the next page, ending with the catchword "qui-" at the lower right.
